A '''battle''' was a battle of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]], in [[3996 BBY]]. At the [[New Apsolon system/Legends|New Apsolon system]], the two sides fought with the Sith emerging as the victors.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is referenced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It only illustrates the battle on the galactic map of the Great Sith War.
